book_metadata.title: Principles of Economics
book_metadata.author: N. Gregory Mankiw
book_metadata.source_file: N Gregory Mankiw - Principles Of Economics 2021 Cengage Learning - libgenli.pdf
book_metadata.artifact_purpose: Source-traceable, decision-oriented economics reasoning operating system for personal, creative, business, and policy reasoning.
book_metadata.personalization_boundary: The user's stability-first, debt-minimization philosophy appears only in operational-application layers and is not attributed to Mankiw.
book_metadata.copyright_handling: Records paraphrase and transform textbook foundations into reasoning metadata; the source text is not reproduced as a substitute for the textbook.

files.description: Complete reasoning OS with all sections and validation summary.
Economic models with assumptions, variables, mechanisms, use limits, and source traces.
Mathematical definitions, identities, and relationships with variable notes.
Curated important graphs with axes, movement/shift logic, welfare areas, and cautions.
Operational decision rules and checklists derived from textbook mechanisms.
Personal finance and human-capital applications with user constraints labeled.
Business operations, automation, pricing, labor, and process applications.
Links to other reasoning modules without implying Mankiw endorsement.
Validation counts, integrity checks, and audit notes.
SHA-256 checksums generated last; excludes its own hash.

checksum_policy: mankiw_checksums.sha256.json is generated after all other JSON files and does not include its own hash.
